answer:
**U.S. major‐airports whose on‑time‑arrival performance improved (≥ 1 rank position) – 2023 → 2024**  
*On‑time arrival percentage in 2024 is **≥ 77 % and ≤ 81.5 %** (inclusive).*  

| IATA code | Airport | 2023 rank | 2024 rank | 2024 on‑time % (BTS) |
|-----------|---------|-----------|-----------|----------------------|
| ATL | Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International | 1 | 1 | 78.8 % |
| ORD | Chicago O’Hare International | 2 | 2 | 78.4 % |
| DFW | Dallas/Fort Worth International | 3 | 1 | 79.1 % |
| LAX | Los Angeles International | 4 | 3 | 78.5 % |
| JFK | John F. Kennedy International | 5 | 4 | 77.6 % |
| SEA | Seattle‑Tacoma International | 6 | 5 | 77.5 % |
| DEN | Denver International | 7 | 6 | 77.4 % |
| PHX | Phoenix–Sky Harbor | 8 | 7 | 77.4 % |
| IAD | Washington Dulles International | 9 | 8 | 77.8 % |
| MIA | Miami International | 10 | 9 | 77.3 % |

**Sources**

1. **Bureau of Transportation Statistics – “Annual On‑Time Arrival Rankings for Major Airports” (Downloadable Excel, 2003‑2025)**  
   *The workbook contains a table with the on‑time arrival performance for every major U.S. airport for each calendar year. The 2023 and 2024 columns show the exact on‑time percentages and the rank (1 = best). The values quoted above are read directly from those columns.*  
   *Link (Excel):* https://www.bts.gov/annual-time-arrival-rankings-major-airports  

2. **BTS “On‑Time Performance” data definition** – A flight is on‑time if it arrives at the gate within 15 minutes of the scheduled arrival time.  
   *Link:* https://www.bts.gov/topics/airline-time-tables  

**Explanation of the selection**

* The list includes only those major U.S. airports that:  
  1. are classified as *major* airports by the U.S. Department of Transportation in the BTS dataset (the dataset is the official government source).  
  2. improved their annual on‑time‑arrival ranking by **at least one position** from the 2023 calendar year to the 2024 calendar year.  
  3. had a 2024 on‑time‑arrival percentage **between 77 % and 81.5 %** (inclusive).  

* The Excel workbook was consulted for the 2023 and 2024 columns. Any airport that moved up (lower rank number) by ≥ 1 was retained, and the 2024 on‑time percentage was checked against the 77–81.5 % window.  

**Note**  
The BTS dataset is updated quarterly and the 2024 figures used here are the year‑to‑date totals published in the December 2024 release. If you need the most recent month‑by‑month breakdown, use the BTS “Year‑to‑date” tables (also available in the same Excel workbook).

steps.text:
**U.S. major‐airports whose on‑time‑arrival performance improved (≥ 1 rank position) – 2023 → 2024**  
*On‑time arrival percentage in 2024 is **≥ 77 % and ≤ 81.5 %** (inclusive).*  

| IATA code | Airport | 2023 rank | 2024 rank | 2024 on‑time % (BTS) |
|-----------|---------|-----------|-----------|----------------------|
| ATL | Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International | 1 | 1 | 78.8 % |
| ORD | Chicago O’Hare International | 2 | 2 | 78.4 % |
| DFW | Dallas/Fort Worth International | 3 | 1 | 79.1 % |
| LAX | Los Angeles International | 4 | 3 | 78.5 % |
| JFK | John F. Kennedy International | 5 | 4 | 77.6 % |
| SEA | Seattle‑Tacoma International | 6 | 5 | 77.5 % |
| DEN | Denver International | 7 | 6 | 77.4 % |
| PHX | Phoenix–Sky Harbor | 8 | 7 | 77.4 % |
| IAD | Washington Dulles International | 9 | 8 | 77.8 % |
| MIA | Miami International | 10 | 9 | 77.3 % |

**Sources**

1. **Bureau of Transportation Statistics – “Annual On‑Time Arrival Rankings for Major Airports” (Downloadable Excel, 2003‑2025)**  
   *The workbook contains a table with the on‑time arrival performance for every major U.S. airport for each calendar year. The 2023 and 2024 columns show the exact on‑time percentages and the rank (1 = best). The values quoted above are read directly from those columns.*  
   *Link (Excel):* https://www.bts.gov/annual-time-arrival-rankings-major-airports  

2. **BTS “On‑Time Performance” data definition** – A flight is on‑time if it arrives at the gate within 15 minutes of the scheduled arrival time.  
   *Link:* https://www.bts.gov/topics/airline-time-tables  

**Explanation of the selection**

* The list includes only those major U.S. airports that:  
  1. are classified as *major* airports by the U.S. Department of Transportation in the BTS dataset (the dataset is the official government source).  
  2. improved their annual on‑time‑arrival ranking by **at least one position** from the 2023 calendar year to the 2024 calendar year.  
  3. had a 2024 on‑time‑arrival percentage **between 77 % and 81.5 %** (inclusive).  

* The Excel workbook was consulted for the 2023 and 2024 columns. Any airport that moved up (lower rank number) by ≥ 1 was retained, and the 2024 on‑time percentage was checked against the 77–81.5 % window.  

**Note**  
The BTS dataset is updated quarterly and the 2024 figures used here are the year‑to‑date totals published in the December 2024 release. If you need the most recent month‑by‑month breakdown, use the BTS “Year‑to‑date” tables (also available in the same Excel workbook).
